narrative.intro: Consolidated Nuclear Security has $489M in contract obligations in FY2027 to date. Consolidated Nuclear Security has one award so far this fiscal year and the average award size is $489M. Consolidated Nuclear Security obligations are down 85.3% year over year. Consolidated Nuclear Security recorded larger annual obligations in prior years: FY22 $3.8B, FY23 $3.3B, FY24 $3.6B, FY25 $2.5B, and FY26 $3.3B. Current-year totals are partial (fiscal year to date). Consolidated Nuclear Security’s single FY2027 award equals the total year-to-date obligations, which makes the average award size equal to the total obligations. Consolidated Nuclear Security stakeholders should note the concentration of obligations into one award for the current fiscal period and the sizable year-over-year decline compared with the recent years that preceded FY2027.
